full_prompt_en: A square painterly fantasy scene shows a white spacecraft passing in front of an ornate towered city beside a harbor. The craft crosses the middle-left horizontally, its blunt white nose pointing right and its darker tail, angled fins, and round engine housings projecting to the left. Gray wear, black openings, and small surface markings break up the pale body, while the underside remains in cooler shadow. Behind it, a dense cluster of slender towers, tiered roofs, domes, and spires rises through the upper center. The central tower is tallest and darkest near its peak; nearby small domes catch muted gold light. Their stone-colored bases merge into a high waterside wall with arches and narrow openings. More low buildings and moored vessels continue along the right-hand shore. At the lower left, a darker boat pushes into the harbor, its shape reflected only faintly in the gray-blue water. Smaller craft sit near the central water lane, providing a scale contrast with the large airborne form. Above, a blue-gray cloudy sky is crossed by pale sunlight and thin veils of haze. Steam or smoke softens portions of the city, especially around the central structures and right side, so the numerous details recede in layers rather than forming a single hard silhouette. Brush marks remain visible across the clouds, water, and masonry, giving the image the texture of an oil-painted concept scene. Light filters from the upper left, striking the top of the spacecraft and the pale stone while leaving its undercarriage and the crowded waterfront darker. The overall composition balances the strong horizontal flight path against clustered vertical towers and a low moving harbor, creating a grand but weathered speculative atmosphere.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画式奇想场景呈现一架白色航天器掠过临港的繁复塔楼城市。飞行器从画面中部偏左水平穿过，钝圆白色机头朝右，较暗的机尾、斜翼和圆形发动机罩伸向左侧。灰色磨损、黑色开口和细小表面标记打断浅色机身，下腹保持较冷的阴影。其后，细长塔楼、层叠屋顶、穹顶和尖塔密集地升至上部中央。中央塔楼最高，顶端附近也最暗；旁边小穹顶接住低调金光。石色底部融入一道高高的临水墙，墙上有拱券和窄小开口。更低的建筑和停泊船只沿右侧海岸延伸。左下方一艘较暗的船驶入港湾，形体在灰蓝水中只有隐约倒影。较小船只位于中央水道附近，与巨大的空中形体形成尺度对比。上方蓝灰色云天被淡日光和薄薄雾霭穿过。蒸汽或烟雾软化城市的一部分，尤其是中央建筑群与右侧，使众多细节层层后退，而非合成一道硬剪影。云、水和石墙里都保留可见笔迹，让画面带有油画式概念场景的肌理。光从左上方过滤下来，照到航天器上部和浅色石墙，使机腹与拥挤码头保持更暗。整体构图以强烈的水平飞行路径平衡密集竖塔和低处活动的港湾，形成宏大却有风化感的幻想气氛。
style_prompt_en: The painterly concept image joins large readable silhouettes with dense clusters of fine structural marks. Blue-gray, stone cream, muted gold, and dark umber dominate, with small light accents appearing through cloudy atmospheric haze. Brushed strokes and rough grain soften surfaces, while selective crisp edges keep the central forms separate from their layered surroundings. Strong horizontal movement cuts across accumulated vertical rhythms, giving the frame both direction and monumental scale. Overlap, tonal recession, and drifting mist make the distant detail dissolve gradually rather than disappear behind a flat backdrop. Diffused upper light finds exposed pale planes and metallic glints; undersides and recesses remain cool and shadowed. The scene is busy near the middle and quieter toward the open upper area and lower color field, maintaining legibility despite abundant detail. The overall effect is cinematic and weathered, with atmospheric depth and textured light holding imaginative forms together.
style_prompt_zh: 这种绘画式概念画面把宽大可辨的剪影与密集的细小结构痕迹结合。蓝灰、石色奶油白、低饱和金色和深棕占主导，少量浅亮重音透过多云雾霭出现。刷涂笔迹和粗细颗粒软化表面，选择性的清晰边缘则让中央形体与层叠环境分开。强烈水平动势切过累积的竖向节奏，让画面同时具有方向感和雄伟尺度。遮挡、明度后退与飘散薄雾让远处细节逐渐消融，而非突然隐入平坦底面。上方散射光找到暴露的浅色体面与金属亮点；下缘及凹处保持偏冷、背光。画面中部较忙碌，上方开放区域和下方色域更安静，因此即使细节繁多仍保持可读。整体效果有电影感而带风化痕迹，以空气纵深和有肌理的光把想象形体组织在一起。
theme_en: A white spacecraft passing an ornate towered harbor city
theme_zh: 一架白色航天器掠过有繁复塔楼的港口城市
name: David Roberts
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
